SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(s.strukturbericht, '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    s.space_group,
    s.space_group_number
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
  AND (
      COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) ILIKE 'L1_2'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) ILIKE 'L12'
      OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) ILIKE 'L1₂'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE s.formula_type IN ('A3B', 'A₃B')
   OR pd.formula_type IN ('A3B', 'A₃B')
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group
FROM structure AS s
JOIN material_entry AS me
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
   OR regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
   OR regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
   OR regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(pd.prototype_name, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE LOWER(s.crystal_system) = 'cubic'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system
FROM material_entry AS me
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fe
  ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE upper(translate(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht, fe.strukturbericht), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉_ -', '0123456789')) = 'L12'
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT me.*
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system,
  COALESCE(s.prototype, fe.prototype, pd.prototype_name) AS prototype,
  COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fe.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht
FROM material_entry AS me
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fe
  ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM composition AS c
  WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    AND c.element = 'Ti'
)
AND (
  regexp_replace(lower(replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
  OR regexp_replace(lower(replace(COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
  OR regexp_replace(lower(replace(COALESCE(fe.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
)
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT formula
FROM material_entry
WHERE number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY formula;

SELECT DISTINCT me.*
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Pt'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1;

SELECT DISTINCT me.*
FROM material_entry AS me
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
);

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE c.element = 'Ga'
  AND (
      lower(replace(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'l12'
      OR lower(replace(replace(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'l12'
      OR lower(coalesce(pd.prototype_name, '')) LIKE '%l1%2%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT c.element
FROM composition AS c
WHERE c.site_label = 'A'
ORDER BY c.element;

SELECT DISTINCT chemical_system
FROM material_entry
WHERE number_of_elements > 1
ORDER BY chemical_system;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.space_group_number
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE lower(s.crystal_system) = 'cubic'
  AND (
      upper(replace(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
      OR upper(replace(replace(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
      OR upper(replace(replace(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
      OR upper(replace(replace(coalesce(pd.prototype_name, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE c.element = 'W'
  AND (
      REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht, '')), '_', ''), '₂', '2') = 'L12'
      OR REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, s.prototype, '')), '_', ''), '₂', '2') LIKE '%L12%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (fh.is_stable IS TRUE OR ps.is_stable IS TRUE)
  AND (
      regexp_replace(replace(upper(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
      OR regexp_replace(replace(upper(coalesce(fh.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
      OR regexp_replace(replace(upper(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
  );

WITH element_sets AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        string_agg(element, '-' ORDER BY element) AS element_combination
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT entry_id, element
        FROM composition
    ) c
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
l12_compounds AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        COALESCE(es.element_combination, me.chemical_system) AS element_combination,
        COALESCE(f.formula, me.formula) AS formula,
        COALESCE(f.reduced_formula, me.reduced_formula) AS reduced_formula,
        f.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
        f.energy_above_hull,
        f.prototype,
        f.strukturbericht,
        f.space_group
    FROM formation_enthalpy f
    JOIN material_entry me
        ON me.entry_id = f.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN element_sets es
        ON es.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE f.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom < 0
      AND regexp_replace(
            upper(translate(COALESCE(f.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
            '[^A-Z0-9]',
            '',
            'g'
          ) = 'L12'
)
SELECT
    element_combination,
    COUNT(*) AS compound_count,
    jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'entry_id', entry_id,
            'formula', formula,
            'reduced_formula', reduced_formula,
            'formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom', formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
            'energy_above_hull', energy_above_hull,
            'prototype', prototype,
            'strukturbericht', strukturbericht,
            'space_group', space_group
        )
        ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC
    ) AS compounds
FROM l12_compounds
GROUP BY element_combination
ORDER BY element_combination;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
    lower(
      regexp_replace(
        translate(
          concat_ws(' ', s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, fh.prototype, fh.strukturbericht, pd.prototype_name, pd.strukturbericht),
          '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉',
          '0123456789'
        ),
        '[^[:alnum:]]',
        '',
        'g'
      )
    ) AS prototype_key
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN composition c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
   AND c.element = 'Al'
  JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE me.number_of_elements > 1
    AND (
      ps.is_stable IS TRUE
      OR fh.is_stable IS TRUE
      OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 1e-6
      OR fh.energy_above_hull <= 1e-6
    )
)
SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  chemical_system,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht,
  energy_above_hull,
  formation_energy_per_atom
FROM candidates
WHERE prototype_key LIKE '%l12%'
ORDER BY reduced_formula, entry_id;

WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ref_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
          OR pd.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
          OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1%2%'
      )
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.lattice_a,
    n.ref_lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - n.ref_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref n
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND n.ref_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3') OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3'))
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR pd.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1%2%'
  )
ORDER BY lattice_a_difference ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  energy_above_hull,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht,
  space_group
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE is_stable IS TRUE
  AND (
    regexp_replace(translate(COALESCE(strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g') ILIKE 'L12'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, pd.prototype_name) AS prototype
FROM material_entry me
LEFT JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, pd.prototype_name) ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, pd.prototype_name) ILIKE '%L12%'
    )
    AND COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) > 0
    AND COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) = FALSE
ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC;

WITH l12_compounds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        COALESCE(
            ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
            fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy,
            fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
        ) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
        ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
    WHERE COALESCE(
            ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
            fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy,
            fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
        ) IS NOT NULL
      AND regexp_replace(
            translate(
                upper(concat_ws(
                    ' ',
                    s.prototype,
                    s.strukturbericht,
                    fh.prototype,
                    fh.strukturbericht,
                    pd.prototype_name,
                    pd.strukturbericht
                )),
                '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉',
                '0123456789'
            ),
            '[^A-Z0-9]',
            '',
            'g'
          ) LIKE '%L12%'
)
SELECT
    ROUND((FLOOR(formation_energy_ev_per_atom / 0.1) * 0.1)::numeric, 2) AS bin_start_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND(((FLOOR(formation_energy_ev_per_atom / 0.1) * 0.1) + 0.1)::numeric, 2) AS bin_end_ev_per_atom,
    COUNT(*) AS compound_count,
    ROUND(AVG(formation_energy_ev_per_atom)::numeric, 4) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM l12_compounds
GROUP BY FLOOR(formation_energy_ev_per_atom / 0.1)
ORDER BY bin_start_ev_per_atom;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_stable
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Co'
)
AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR pd.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1₂%'
)
ORDER BY
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) DESC NULLS LAST,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) ASC NULLS LAST;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a_angstrom,
  COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
  s.space_group_number,
  COALESCE(s.space_group, fh.space_group) AS space_group
FROM material_entry AS me
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) >= 3.5
  AND (
    UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht), '₂', '2')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY lattice_a_angstrom, me.reduced_formula;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
  AND (
      upper(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), ' ', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
      OR upper(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), ' ', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
      OR upper(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '_', ''), ' ', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
      OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    fh.entry_id,
    fh.formula,
    fh.reduced_formula,
    fh.energy_above_hull,
    fh.strukturbericht
FROM formation_enthalpy AS fh
WHERE fh.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
  AND REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(fh.strukturbericht), '_', ''), '₂', '2') = 'L12'
ORDER BY fh.energy_above_hull, fh.reduced_formula;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM composition AS c
  WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    AND c.element = 'Ti'
)
AND regexp_replace(
      upper(translate(concat_ws(' ', s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, s.prototype, fh.prototype),
                      '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
      '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
    ) LIKE '%L12%'
ORDER BY me.formula;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system
FROM material_entry AS me
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fe
    ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE me.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM (VALUES
          (s.strukturbericht),
          (fe.strukturbericht),
          (pd.strukturbericht),
          (s.prototype),
          (fe.prototype),
          (pd.prototype_name)
      ) AS v(label)
      WHERE regexp_replace(
                upper(translate(coalesce(v.label, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
                '[^A-Z0-9]',
                '',
                'g'
            ) = 'L12'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a_angstrom,
  fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  fh.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE fh.is_stable = TRUE
  AND COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) < 3.6
  AND (
    UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(fh.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY lattice_a_angstrom;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    nb.nb_atomic_fraction,
    COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, pd.prototype_name) AS prototype,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull, pde.hull_distance) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable, pde.is_on_hull) AS is_stable,
    COALESCE(s.space_group, fh.space_group) AS space_group,
    s.crystal_system,
    ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry me
JOIN (
    SELECT entry_id, SUM(atomic_fraction) AS nb_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition
    WHERE element = 'Nb'
    GROUP BY entry_id
) nb ON nb.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
    OR regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
    OR regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
    OR regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
    OR regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(fh.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
    OR regexp_replace(lower(replace(coalesce(pd.prototype_name, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
ORDER BY energy_above_hull NULLS LAST, me.formula;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.lattice_b,
    s.lattice_c
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE c.element = 'Sc'
  AND (
      regexp_replace(translate(upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
      OR regexp_replace(translate(upper(COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
      OR regexp_replace(translate(upper(COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
  )
ORDER BY me.formula;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
    fe.energy_above_hull,
    fe.prototype,
    fe.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fe
    ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE fe.is_stable IS TRUE
  AND (
      upper(regexp_replace(replace(COALESCE(fe.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
      OR upper(regexp_replace(replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
      OR fe.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE (
    regexp_replace(translate(upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
    OR regexp_replace(translate(upper(COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, '')), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
)
AND COALESCE(me.chemical_system, '') NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.formula;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site_element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM structure s
JOIN composition c
  ON c.entry_id = s.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE c.site_label = 'A'
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR pd.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC, c.element;

SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE lower(replace(replace(strukturbericht, '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'l12'
  AND formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE s.lattice_a >= 4.0
  AND (
    UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
    OR COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
  )
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
  f.entry_id,
  f.formula,
  f.reduced_formula,
  f.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM formation_enthalpy AS f
JOIN material_entry AS me
  ON me.entry_id = f.entry_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = f.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS p
  ON p.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM composition AS c
  WHERE c.entry_id = f.entry_id
    AND c.element = 'Pd'
)
AND (
  upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(f.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
  OR upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
  OR upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(p.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
  OR upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(f.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
  OR upper(regexp_replace(replace(coalesce(p.prototype_name, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
)
ORDER BY f.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

WITH cu_l12 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
        ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition c
        WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND c.element = 'Cu'
    )
      AND regexp_replace(
            translate(
                upper(concat_ws(' ', s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, pd.prototype_name, pd.strukturbericht)),
                '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉',
                '0123456789'
            ),
            '[^A-Z0-9]',
            '',
            'g'
          ) LIKE '%L12%'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN is_stable = TRUE OR energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN 'stable'
        WHEN energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 'metastable'
        ELSE 'unstable'
    END AS stability_class,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    energy_above_hull
FROM cu_l12
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN is_stable = TRUE OR energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN 1
        WHEN energy_above_hull <= 0.05 THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    energy_above_hull,
    formula;

SELECT
  c.element AS b_site_element,
  AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_per_atom
FROM composition AS c
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'B'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.volume_per_atom,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON s.prototype = pd.prototype_id
WHERE s.volume_per_atom <= 12
  AND (
      upper(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
      OR upper(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
      OR upper(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
      OR upper(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(pd.prototype_name, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom, me.formula;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system,
  ir.ir_atomic_fraction,
  s.prototype,
  COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
  s.space_group,
  s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN (
  SELECT entry_id, SUM(atomic_fraction) AS ir_atomic_fraction
  FROM composition
  WHERE element = 'Ir'
  GROUP BY entry_id
) AS ir
  ON ir.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE me.number_of_elements > 1
  AND (
    upper(replace(replace(s.strukturbericht, '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(replace(replace(pd.strukturbericht, '_', ''), '₂', '2')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(replace(replace(s.prototype, '_', ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
  )
ORDER BY me.reduced_formula, me.entry_id;

SELECT
  me.chemical_system,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS compound_count,
  ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT me.reduced_formula ORDER BY me.reduced_formula) AS compounds
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE me.number_of_elements = 2
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR pd.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
GROUP BY me.chemical_system
ORDER BY me.chemical_system;

SELECT entry_id, formula, reduced_formula, lattice_a
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L1₂', 'L12')
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
  AND lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lattice_a DESC;

WITH l12_structures AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.entry_id)
        s.entry_id,
        s.prototype,
        COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.space_group,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.volume_per_atom
    FROM structure s
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
        ON s.prototype = pd.prototype_id
    WHERE
        regexp_replace(upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
        OR regexp_replace(upper(COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
        OR COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, '') ILIKE '%L1₂%'
        OR concat_ws(' ', s.prototype, pd.prototype_id, pd.prototype_name) ILIKE '%Cu3Au%'
    ORDER BY s.entry_id, s.structure_id
),
composition_summary AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(atomic_fraction) FILTER (WHERE element = 'Ni'), 0) AS ni_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
stability_summary AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        MIN(formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
        MIN(energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        BOOL_OR(is_stable) AS is_stable
    FROM (
        SELECT
            entry_id,
            formation_energy_per_atom,
            energy_above_hull,
            is_stable
        FROM phase_stability
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            entry_id,
            formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom AS formation_energy_per_atom,
            energy_above_hull,
            is_stable
        FROM formation_enthalpy
    ) x
    GROUP BY entry_id
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    cs.ni_atomic_fraction,
    ls.prototype,
    ls.strukturbericht,
    ls.space_group_number,
    ls.space_group,
    ss.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ss.energy_above_hull,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(ss.is_stable, FALSE) OR ss.energy_above_hull <= 0.001 THEN 'stable'
        ELSE 'metastable'
    END AS stability_class
FROM material_entry me
JOIN l12_structures ls
    ON me.entry_id = ls.entry_id
JOIN composition_summary cs
    ON me.entry_id = cs.entry_id
JOIN stability_summary ss
    ON me.entry_id = ss.entry_id
WHERE
    cs.ni_atomic_fraction BETWEEN 0.70 AND 0.80
    AND (
        ss.is_stable IS TRUE
        OR ss.energy_above_hull <= 0.10
    )
ORDER BY
    ss.energy_above_hull NULLS LAST,
    me.reduced_formula;

WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
        fh.energy_above_hull,
        fh.is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE
        UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, ''), '_', '')) IN ('L12', 'L1₂')
        OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '')) LIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR UPPER(COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, '')) LIKE '%L12%'
),
site_elements AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        MAX(c.element) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.site_label) LIKE 'A%') AS a_site_element,
        MAX(c.element) FILTER (WHERE UPPER(c.site_label) LIKE 'B%') AS b_site_element
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT
    se.a_site_element,
    se.b_site_element,
    COUNT(*) AS num_compounds,
    AVG(l12.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    STDDEV_SAMP(l12.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS stddev_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    MIN(l12.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS min_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    MAX(l12.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS max_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    AVG(l12.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l12.is_stable) AS num_stable_compounds,
    ARRAY_AGG(l12.formula ORDER BY l12.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formulas_ordered_by_formation_energy
FROM l12_entries l12
JOIN site_elements se
    ON se.entry_id = l12.entry_id
WHERE
    se.a_site_element IS NOT NULL
    AND se.b_site_element IS NOT NULL
    AND l12.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    se.a_site_element,
    se.b_site_element
ORDER BY
    avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom ASC;

WITH ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND (
          s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
          OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
          OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group,
    s.lattice_a,
    n.ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - n.ni3al_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    100.0 * ABS(s.lattice_a - n.ni3al_lattice_a) / n.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
    fh.energy_above_hull,
    fh.is_stable
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref n
WHERE (
        s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
        OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      )
  AND me.reduced_formula NOT IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom < 0
  AND 100.0 * ABS(s.lattice_a - n.ni3al_lattice_a) / n.ni3al_lattice_a <= 2.0
ORDER BY
    fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC,
    lattice_mismatch_percent ASC;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fe
  ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
WHERE fe.is_stable = TRUE
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(fe.strukturbericht, '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', '')) = 'L12'
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    fe.entry_id,
    fe.formula,
    fe.reduced_formula,
    fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM formation_enthalpy AS fe
WHERE fe.is_stable IS TRUE
  AND fe.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L1_2', 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition AS c
      WHERE c.entry_id = fe.entry_id
        AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site_element,
  AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.entry_id) AS compound_count
FROM structure s
JOIN composition c
  ON c.entry_id = s.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE c.site_label = 'A'
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR pd.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element;

SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  lattice_a,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht,
  space_group
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
  AND (
    strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L1₂', 'L12')
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE et.bulk_modulus_vrh >= 180
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR pd.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

WITH ni3al AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ref_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L1₂'
      AND me.number_of_elements = 2
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Ni'
            AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.75) < 0.01
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Al'
            AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.25) < 0.01
      )
),
co_l12 AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        s.lattice_a,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        ps.is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L1₂'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Co'
            AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
      )
)
SELECT
    co_l12.entry_id,
    co_l12.formula,
    co_l12.reduced_formula,
    co_l12.lattice_a,
    ni3al.ref_lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    ABS(co_l12.lattice_a - ni3al.ref_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_difference,
    co_l12.energy_above_hull,
    co_l12.is_stable
FROM co_l12
CROSS JOIN ni3al
WHERE ni3al.ref_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    co_l12.is_stable DESC NULLS LAST,
    co_l12.energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST,
    lattice_a_difference ASC;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  c.element AS b_site_element,
  fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  AND c.site_label = 'B'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  et.shear_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
JOIN calculation AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
WHERE et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')), '_', ''), '₂', '2') = 'L12'
    OR replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, '')), '_', ''), '₂', '2') = 'L12'
  );

SELECT
  fh.entry_id,
  fh.formula,
  fh.reduced_formula,
  fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  fh.energy_above_hull,
  fh.prototype,
  fh.strukturbericht,
  fh.space_group
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
WHERE fh.is_stable = TRUE
  AND fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND upper(regexp_replace(replace(COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g')) = 'L12'
ORDER BY fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    AVG(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh_gpa,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS comp
    WHERE comp.entry_id = me.entry_id
      AND comp.element = 'Ni'
)
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site_element,
  AVG(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
JOIN composition c
  ON c.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE fh.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A'
  AND fh.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
JOIN calculation AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
WHERE et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.50 AND 3.60
  AND regexp_replace(
        upper(translate(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht, s.prototype, pd.prototype_name, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')),
        '[^A-Z0-9]',
        '',
        'g'
      ) = 'L12'
GROUP BY
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  s.lattice_a
ORDER BY
  MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) DESC,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  corr(s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) OVER () AS pearson_correlation
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
  (
    s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
  )
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.lattice_a;

WITH lattice_constants AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (material)
         material,
         lattice_a
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN formula = 'Co3Ti' OR reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti' THEN 'Co3Ti'
        WHEN formula = 'Ni3Al' OR reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al' THEN 'Ni3Al'
      END AS material,
      lattice_a,
      energy_above_hull
    FROM formation_enthalpy
    WHERE (formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al') OR reduced_formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al'))
      AND lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  ) t
  WHERE material IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY material, energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT
  co.lattice_a AS co3ti_lattice_a,
  ni.lattice_a AS ni3al_lattice_a,
  co.lattice_a - ni.lattice_a AS lattice_a_difference,
  ABS(co.lattice_a - ni.lattice_a) AS absolute_lattice_a_difference
FROM lattice_constants co
JOIN lattice_constants ni ON co.material = 'Co3Ti' AND ni.material = 'Ni3Al';

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT fh.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE fh.is_stable) AS stable_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fh.entry_id) FILTER (WHERE NOT fh.is_stable) AS unstable_count
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
JOIN composition c
  ON c.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
  AND (
    fh.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR fh.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  );

SELECT
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC) AS rank,
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  energy_above_hull,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE
  energy_above_hull > 0
  AND COALESCE(is_stable, FALSE) = FALSE
  AND UPPER(REPLACE(strukturbericht, '₂', '2')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
ORDER BY energy_above_hull ASC;

SELECT
  c.element AS b_site_element,
  COUNT(DISTINCT me.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry me
JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN composition c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE fh.is_stable IS TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'B'
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_compound_count DESC, b_site_element;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
  s.prototype,
  c.calculation_id,
  c.method,
  c.functional,
  c.calculation_type,
  cp.property_name,
  cp.value,
  cp.unit,
  cp.tensor_component
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
JOIN calculation AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property AS cp
  ON cp.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
WHERE
  (
    UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')) IN ('L12', 'L1_2')
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L1_2%'
  )
  AND (
    c.method ILIKE '%DFT%'
    OR c.calculation_type ILIKE '%DFT%'
  )
ORDER BY
  me.reduced_formula,
  cp.property_name,
  c.calculation_id;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE UPPER(c.functional) = 'PBE'
  AND (
    UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
    OR UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', '')) LIKE '%L12%'
  );

WITH ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM structure s
    JOIN material_entry me ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND upper(replace(replace(s.strukturbericht, '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
      AND (
          me.formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
          OR me.reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      )
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ref.ni3al_lattice_a,
    100.0 * (s.lattice_a - ref.ni3al_lattice_a) / ref.ni3al_lattice_a AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    ABS(100.0 * (s.lattice_a - ref.ni3al_lattice_a) / ref.ni3al_lattice_a) AS abs_lattice_mismatch_percent
FROM structure s
JOIN material_entry me ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ref
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ref.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND upper(replace(replace(s.strukturbericht, '₂', '2'), '_', '')) = 'L12'
ORDER BY abs_lattice_mismatch_percent ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.strukturbericht,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable AS thermodynamically_stable,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    et.shear_modulus_vrh,
    et.youngs_modulus,
    et.poisson_ratio,
    et.is_stable AS elastically_stable
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN composition AS comp
    ON comp.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS calc
    ON calc.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE comp.element = 'Fe'
  AND (
      s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
      OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    COALESCE(fh.formula, me.formula) AS formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
    et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus_gpa
FROM material_entry AS me
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS c
    ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
    ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
LEFT JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE (fh.is_stable IS TRUE OR ps.is_stable IS TRUE)
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh >= 160
  AND regexp_replace(
        upper(replace(concat_ws(' ', s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, pd.prototype_id, pd.prototype_name, pd.strukturbericht, fh.prototype, fh.strukturbericht), '₂', '2')),
        '[^A-Z0-9]',
        '',
        'g'
      ) LIKE '%L12%';

WITH ni3al_ref AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull)) AS ref_energy_above_hull,
    AVG(COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a)) AS ref_lattice_a
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Ni'
        AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.75) < 0.02
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
        AND c.element = 'Al'
        AND ABS(c.atomic_fraction - 0.25) < 0.02
    )
),
candidates AS (
  SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
    COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_stable,
    COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
    s.space_group,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht
  FROM material_entry me
  JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
  LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
  WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
)
SELECT
  c.entry_id,
  c.formula,
  c.reduced_formula,
  c.chemical_system,
  c.energy_above_hull,
  c.is_stable,
  c.lattice_a,
  ABS(c.energy_above_hull - r.ref_energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_diff_from_ni3al,
  ABS(c.lattice_a - r.ref_lattice_a) AS lattice_a_diff_from_ni3al,
  c.space_group,
  c.space_group_number,
  c.prototype,
  c.strukturbericht
FROM candidates c
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
WHERE c.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
  AND c.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM composition cn
      WHERE cn.entry_id = c.entry_id
        AND cn.element = 'Ni'
        AND ABS(cn.atomic_fraction - 0.75) < 0.02
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM composition ca
      WHERE ca.entry_id = c.entry_id
        AND ca.element = 'Al'
        AND ABS(ca.atomic_fraction - 0.25) < 0.02
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  ABS(c.energy_above_hull - r.ref_energy_above_hull),
  ABS(c.lattice_a - r.ref_lattice_a)
LIMIT 20;

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
    (
        s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition AS ca
        WHERE ca.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND ca.site_label = 'A'
          AND ca.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
    )
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition AS cb
        WHERE cb.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND cb.site_label = 'B'
          AND cb.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
    );

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.lattice_a,
  4.0 / POWER(s.lattice_a, 3) AS atoms_per_volume
FROM structure s
JOIN material_entry me
  ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
  )
ORDER BY s.lattice_a;

SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  energy_above_hull,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE energy_above_hull = 0
  AND formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom <= -0.4
  AND REPLACE(REPLACE(strukturbericht, '₂', '2'), '_', '') = 'L12';

SELECT DISTINCT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
    ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
    ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
LEFT JOIN phase_stability AS ps
    ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy AS fh
    ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE me.number_of_elements > 1
  AND (
        REPLACE(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '_', '') ILIKE 'L12'
        OR REPLACE(COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '_', '') ILIKE 'L12'
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR COALESCE(s.prototype, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
        OR COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, '') ILIKE '%L1_2%'
        OR COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, '') ILIKE '%L12%'
      )
  AND (
        ps.is_stable IS TRUE
        OR fh.is_stable IS TRUE
        OR COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) <= 0.0
      )
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM composition AS c
        JOIN element AS e
            ON e.symbol = c.element
        WHERE c.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND (
                e.category ILIKE '%transition metal%'
                OR e.block = 'd'
              )
      );

WITH l12_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        als.system_name,
        s.structure_id,
        s.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system,
        COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable) AS is_phase_stable,
        COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN alloy_system als
        ON als.alloy_system_id = mas.alloy_system_id
    WHERE me.number_of_elements >= 2
      AND (
            s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1_2'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L12'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'L1₂'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
      )
      AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
),
elastic AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh,
        MAX(et.shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_vrh,
        MAX(et.youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus,
        AVG(et.poisson_ratio) AS poisson_ratio,
        BOOL_OR(et.is_stable) AS is_elastically_stable
    FROM calculation c
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
matrix_phases AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        s.lattice_a AS matrix_lattice_a
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN material_alloy_system mas
        ON mas.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
            mas.phase ILIKE '%matrix%'
         OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE 'A1'
         OR s.prototype ILIKE '%fcc%'
         OR s.crystal_system ILIKE 'cubic'
      )
)
SELECT
    l.entry_id,
    l.formula,
    l.reduced_formula,
    l.chemical_system,
    l.system_name,
    l.space_group_number,
    l.precipitate_lattice_a,
    m.entry_id AS matrix_entry_id,
    m.formula AS matrix_formula,
    m.matrix_lattice_a,
    100.0 * (l.precipitate_lattice_a - m.matrix_lattice_a) / m.matrix_lattice_a AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    l.energy_above_hull,
    l.formation_energy_per_atom,
    e.bulk_modulus_vrh,
    e.shear_modulus_vrh,
    e.youngs_modulus,
    e.poisson_ratio
FROM l12_candidates l
JOIN elastic e
    ON e.entry_id = l.entry_id
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT mp.*
    FROM matrix_phases mp
    WHERE mp.alloy_system_id = l.alloy_system_id
      AND mp.entry_id <> l.entry_id
    ORDER BY ABS((l.precipitate_lattice_a - mp.matrix_lattice_a) / mp.matrix_lattice_a)
    LIMIT 1
) m ON TRUE
WHERE COALESCE(l.is_phase_stable, FALSE) = TRUE
  AND l.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND ABS((l.precipitate_lattice_a - m.matrix_lattice_a) / m.matrix_lattice_a) <= 0.02
  AND COALESCE(e.is_elastically_stable, FALSE) = TRUE
  AND e.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND e.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    l.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ABS((l.precipitate_lattice_a - m.matrix_lattice_a) / m.matrix_lattice_a) ASC,
    e.shear_modulus_vrh DESC;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.reduced_formula,
  me.chemical_system,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.space_group,
  s.crystal_system,
  COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
  COALESCE(fh.is_stable, ps.is_stable) AS thermodynamically_stable,
  s.lattice_a,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh,
  et.shear_modulus_vrh,
  et.youngs_modulus,
  et.poisson_ratio,
  et.is_stable AS elastically_stable
FROM material_entry me
JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et
  ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
WHERE
  (
    s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.strukturbericht ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR s.formula_type ILIKE 'A3B'
    OR s.formula_type ILIKE 'AB3'
  )
  AND COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) < 0
  AND COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull, 0) <= 0.05
  AND et.is_stable = TRUE
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND et.shear_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND et.youngs_modulus IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.45 AND 3.75
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull, 0) ASC,
  COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) ASC,
  et.youngs_modulus DESC,
  et.shear_modulus_vrh DESC;

WITH gamma_prime_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mas.entry_id,
        mas.alloy_system_id,
        mas.phase AS gamma_prime_phase
    FROM material_alloy_system mas
    WHERE mas.phase ILIKE ANY (
        ARRAY[
            $$%γ'%$$,
            $$%γ-prime%$$,
            $$%γ prime%$$,
            $$%gamma'%$$,
            $$%gamma-prime%$$,
            $$%gamma prime%$$
        ]
    )
),
gamma_matrix_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mas.entry_id,
        mas.alloy_system_id
    FROM material_alloy_system mas
    WHERE (mas.phase ILIKE $$%γ%$$ OR mas.phase ILIKE $$%gamma%$$)
      AND NOT (
          mas.phase ILIKE ANY (
              ARRAY[
                  $$%γ'%$$,
                  $$%γ-prime%$$,
                  $$%γ prime%$$,
                  $$%gamma'%$$,
                  $$%gamma-prime%$$,
                  $$%gamma prime%$$
              ]
          )
      )
),
features AS (
    SELECT
        gp.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        a.system_name,
        gp.gamma_prime_phase,
        stability.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        gp_lattice.gamma_prime_lattice_a,
        lattice_match.lattice_misfit,
        bulk.bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM gamma_prime_entries gp
    JOIN material_entry me
        ON me.entry_id = gp.entry_id
    JOIN alloy_system a
        ON a.alloy_system_id = gp.alloy_system_id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MIN(x.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom
        FROM (
            SELECT ps.energy_above_hull
            FROM phase_stability ps
            WHERE ps.entry_id = gp.entry_id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT fh.energy_above_hull
            FROM formation_enthalpy fh
            WHERE fh.entry_id = gp.entry_id
            UNION ALL
            SELECT pde.hull_distance
            FROM phase_diagram_entry pde
            WHERE pde.entry_id = gp.entry_id
        ) x
        WHERE x.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
    ) stability ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT AVG(s.lattice_a) AS gamma_prime_lattice_a
        FROM structure s
        WHERE s.entry_id = gp.entry_id
          AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
          AND s.lattice_a > 0
    ) gp_lattice ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MIN(ABS(gp_lattice.gamma_prime_lattice_a - sm.lattice_a) / NULLIF(sm.lattice_a, 0)) AS lattice_misfit
        FROM gamma_matrix_entries gm
        JOIN structure sm
            ON sm.entry_id = gm.entry_id
        WHERE gm.alloy_system_id = gp.alloy_system_id
          AND sm.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
          AND sm.lattice_a > 0
          AND gp_lattice.gamma_prime_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    ) lattice_match ON TRUE
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT AVG(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh
        FROM calculation c
        JOIN elastic_tensor et
            ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
        WHERE c.entry_id = gp.entry_id
          AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    ) bulk ON TRUE
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM features
    WHERE energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND gamma_prime_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND lattice_misfit IS NOT NULL
      AND bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom) AS min_ehull,
        MAX(energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom) AS max_ehull,
        MIN(lattice_misfit) AS min_misfit,
        MAX(lattice_misfit) AS max_misfit,
        MIN(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS min_bulk,
        MAX(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS max_bulk
    FROM filtered
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        CASE
            WHEN s.max_ehull = s.min_ehull THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 - ((f.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom - s.min_ehull) / NULLIF(s.max_ehull - s.min_ehull, 0))
        END AS stability_score,
        CASE
            WHEN s.max_misfit = s.min_misfit THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 - ((f.lattice_misfit - s.min_misfit) / NULLIF(s.max_misfit - s.min_misfit, 0))
        END AS lattice_match_score,
        CASE
            WHEN s.max_bulk = s.min_bulk THEN 1.0
            ELSE (f.bulk_modulus_vrh - s.min_bulk) / NULLIF(s.max_bulk - s.min_bulk, 0)
        END AS bulk_modulus_score
    FROM filtered f
    CROSS JOIN stats s
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        0.4 * stability_score
        + 0.3 * lattice_match_score
        + 0.3 * bulk_modulus_score AS weighted_score
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY weighted_score DESC) AS candidate_rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    system_name,
    gamma_prime_phase,
    energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    gamma_prime_lattice_a,
    lattice_misfit * 100.0 AS lattice_misfit_percent,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    stability_score,
    lattice_match_score,
    bulk_modulus_score,
    weighted_score
FROM ranked
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC, energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC, lattice_misfit ASC, bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh,
        MIN(LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull, pde.hull_distance)) AS energy_above_hull
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
        ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
    JOIN calculation c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde
        ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition comp
          WHERE comp.entry_id = me.entry_id
            AND comp.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
            AND COALESCE(comp.atomic_fraction, 0) > 0
      )
      AND (
          ps.is_stable IS TRUE
          OR fh.is_stable IS TRUE
          OR pde.is_on_hull IS TRUE
      )
      AND upper(
          regexp_replace(
              translate(
                  concat_ws(' ', s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, pd.prototype_id, pd.prototype_name, pd.strukturbericht),
                  '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉₂',
                  '01234567892'
              ),
              '[^A-Za-z0-9]',
              '',
              'g'
          )
      ) LIKE '%L12%'
    GROUP BY me.entry_id, me.formula, me.reduced_formula
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    bulk_modulus_vrh,
    energy_above_hull
FROM candidates
ORDER BY bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT me.entry_id, me.formula, me.reduced_formula
    FROM material_entry me
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM structure s
        LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
        WHERE s.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND (
              regexp_replace(lower(translate(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
              OR regexp_replace(lower(translate(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
              OR regexp_replace(lower(translate(coalesce(s.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
              OR regexp_replace(lower(translate(coalesce(pd.prototype_name, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
          )
    )
    OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM formation_enthalpy fh
        WHERE fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
          AND (
              regexp_replace(lower(translate(coalesce(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'l12'
              OR regexp_replace(lower(translate(coalesce(fh.prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%l12%'
          )
    )
),
comp AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        c.element,
        SUM(c.atomic_fraction) AS atomic_fraction,
        STRING_AGG(coalesce(c.site_label, ''), ' ') AS site_labels
    FROM composition c
    JOIN l12_entries le ON le.entry_id = c.entry_id
    GROUP BY c.entry_id, c.element
),
comp_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        comp.*,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY entry_id) AS n_elements,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entry_id ORDER BY atomic_fraction ASC NULLS LAST, element) AS frac_asc_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entry_id ORDER BY atomic_fraction DESC NULLS LAST, element) AS frac_desc_rank
    FROM comp
),
site_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(element) FILTER (WHERE site_labels ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])A([^[:alnum:]]|$)|A[-_ ]?SITE'),
            MAX(element) FILTER (WHERE n_elements = 2 AND frac_asc_rank = 1)
        ) AS a_site_element,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(element) FILTER (WHERE site_labels ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])B([^[:alnum:]]|$)|B[-_ ]?SITE'),
            MAX(element) FILTER (WHERE n_elements = 2 AND frac_desc_rank = 1)
        ) AS b_site_element
    FROM comp_ranked
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
ps AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        BOOL_OR(is_stable) AS is_stable,
        MIN(energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        MIN(formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy
    FROM phase_stability
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
fh AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        BOOL_OR(is_stable) AS is_stable,
        MIN(energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        MIN(formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy
    FROM formation_enthalpy
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
pde AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        BOOL_OR(is_on_hull) AS is_stable,
        MIN(hull_distance) AS energy_above_hull
    FROM phase_diagram_entry
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
entry_stability_raw AS (
    SELECT
        le.entry_id,
        le.formula,
        le.reduced_formula,
        LEAST(
            COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, 'Infinity'::double precision),
            COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, 'Infinity'::double precision),
            COALESCE(pde.energy_above_hull, 'Infinity'::double precision)
        ) AS raw_energy_above_hull,
        COALESCE(ps.is_stable, FALSE) OR COALESCE(fh.is_stable, FALSE) OR COALESCE(pde.is_stable, FALSE) AS reported_stable,
        COALESCE(ps.formation_energy, fh.formation_energy) AS formation_energy
    FROM l12_entries le
    LEFT JOIN ps ON ps.entry_id = le.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN fh ON fh.entry_id = le.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN pde ON pde.entry_id = le.entry_id
),
entry_stability AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        formula,
        reduced_formula,
        NULLIF(raw_energy_above_hull, 'Infinity'::double precision) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        reported_stable OR raw_energy_above_hull <= 1e-8 AS is_stable,
        formation_energy AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
    FROM entry_stability_raw
)
SELECT
    sp.a_site_element,
    sp.b_site_element,
    COUNT(*) AS l12_compound_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE es.is_stable) AS stable_count,
    ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE es.is_stable))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS stable_fraction,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE es.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom <= 0.05) AS within_50mev_hull_count,
    ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE es.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom <= 0.05))::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS within_50mev_hull_fraction,
    ROUND(AVG(es.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom)::numeric, 4) AS avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND(MIN(es.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom)::numeric, 4) AS min_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND(AVG(es.formation_energy_ev_per_atom)::numeric, 4) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    (ARRAY_AGG(es.formula ORDER BY es.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom NULLS LAST))[1:5] AS representative_formulas
FROM site_pairs sp
JOIN entry_stability es ON es.entry_id = sp.entry_id
WHERE sp.a_site_element IS NOT NULL
  AND sp.b_site_element IS NOT NULL
  AND sp.a_site_element <> sp.b_site_element
GROUP BY sp.a_site_element, sp.b_site_element
ORDER BY stable_fraction DESC NULLS LAST, avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST, l12_compound_count DESC;

WITH composition_summary AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Ni' THEN atomic_fraction ELSE 0 END) AS ni_fraction,
        SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Al' THEN atomic_fraction ELSE 0 END) AS al_fraction,
        COUNT(DISTINCT element) AS n_elements
    FROM composition
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
l12_structures AS (
    SELECT
        s.entry_id,
        AVG(s.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT COALESCE(s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, pd.prototype_name), ', ') AS l12_identifier
    FROM structure s
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
        ON s.prototype = pd.prototype_id
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND CONCAT_WS(' ', s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, s.formula_type,
                    pd.prototype_name, pd.strukturbericht, pd.formula_type)
          ILIKE ANY (ARRAY['%L12%', '%L1_2%', '%L1-2%', '%L1 2%', '%L1₂%', '%Cu3Au%', '%Cu₃Au%'])
    GROUP BY s.entry_id
),
ni3al_reference AS (
    SELECT AVG(l.lattice_a) AS ref_lattice_a
    FROM l12_structures l
    JOIN material_entry me
        ON me.entry_id = l.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN composition_summary cs
        ON cs.entry_id = l.entry_id
    WHERE (
        cs.n_elements = 2
        AND ABS(cs.ni_fraction - 0.75) <= 0.02
        AND ABS(cs.al_fraction - 0.25) <= 0.02
    )
    OR REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(me.reduced_formula, me.formula, ''), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
),
bulk_moduli AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM calculation c
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
    WHERE et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(et.is_stable, TRUE)
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
stability AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        BOOL_OR(COALESCE(is_stable, energy_above_hull <= 1e-6, FALSE)) AS is_stable,
        MIN(energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull
    FROM (
        SELECT entry_id, is_stable, energy_above_hull
        FROM phase_stability
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entry_id, is_stable, energy_above_hull
        FROM formation_enthalpy
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entry_id, is_on_hull AS is_stable, hull_distance AS energy_above_hull
        FROM phase_diagram_entry
    ) x
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        l.l12_identifier,
        l.lattice_a,
        r.ref_lattice_a,
        ABS(l.lattice_a - r.ref_lattice_a) / r.ref_lattice_a AS lattice_mismatch_fraction,
        b.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        st.energy_above_hull
    FROM l12_structures l
    JOIN material_entry me
        ON me.entry_id = l.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN ni3al_reference r
    JOIN bulk_moduli b
        ON b.entry_id = l.entry_id
    JOIN stability st
        ON st.entry_id = l.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN composition_summary cs
        ON cs.entry_id = l.entry_id
    WHERE r.ref_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(st.is_stable, FALSE)
      AND NOT (
          (
              cs.n_elements = 2
