              AND ABS(cs.ni_fraction - 0.75) <= 0.02
              AND ABS(cs.al_fraction - 0.25) <= 0.02
          )
          OR REGEXP_REPLACE(COALESCE(me.reduced_formula, me.formula, ''), '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      )
      AND ABS(l.lattice_a - r.ref_lattice_a) / r.ref_lattice_a <= 0.05
),
score_components AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        GREATEST(0.0, 1.0 - c.lattice_mismatch_fraction / 0.05) AS lattice_score,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(c.bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER () = MIN(c.bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER () THEN 1.0
            ELSE (c.bulk_modulus_vrh - MIN(c.bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER ())
                 / NULLIF(MAX(c.bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER () - MIN(c.bulk_modulus_vrh) OVER (), 0)
        END AS bulk_score,
        CASE
            WHEN MAX(COALESCE(c.energy_above_hull, 0.0)) OVER () = MIN(COALESCE(c.energy_above_hull, 0.0)) OVER () THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 - (
                (COALESCE(c.energy_above_hull, 0.0) - MIN(COALESCE(c.energy_above_hull, 0.0)) OVER ())
                / NULLIF(MAX(COALESCE(c.energy_above_hull, 0.0)) OVER () - MIN(COALESCE(c.energy_above_hull, 0.0)) OVER (), 0)
            )
        END AS stability_score
    FROM candidates c
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        0.45 * lattice_score + 0.45 * bulk_score + 0.10 * stability_score AS composite_score
    FROM score_components
)
SELECT
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY composite_score DESC,
                 bulk_modulus_vrh DESC,
                 lattice_mismatch_fraction ASC,
                 energy_above_hull ASC NULLS LAST
    ) AS candidate_rank,
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    chemical_system,
    l12_identifier,
    ROUND(lattice_a::numeric, 4) AS lattice_a,
    ROUND(ref_lattice_a::numeric, 4) AS ni3al_lattice_a,
    ROUND((100.0 * lattice_mismatch_fraction)::numeric, 3) AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    ROUND(bulk_modulus_vrh::numeric, 2) AS bulk_modulus_vrh_gpa,
    ROUND(energy_above_hull::numeric, 5) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND(composite_score::numeric, 4) AS composite_score
FROM scored
ORDER BY candidate_rank, entry_id;

WITH l12_structures AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.entry_id)
        s.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        s.lattice_a,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.crystal_system
    FROM structure s
    JOIN material_entry me ON me.entry_id = s.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
    WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          upper(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(concat_ws(' ', s.strukturbericht, s.prototype, pd.strukturbericht, pd.prototype_name, pd.prototype_id), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', ''), '₁', '1'), '₂', '2')) LIKE '%L12%'
          OR upper(concat_ws(' ', s.prototype, pd.prototype_name, pd.prototype_id)) LIKE '%CU3AU%'
      )
    ORDER BY s.entry_id, s.lattice_a DESC
),
majority_component AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (entry_id)
        entry_id,
        element AS matrix_element,
        atomic_fraction AS matrix_atomic_fraction
    FROM composition
    WHERE atomic_fraction IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY entry_id, atomic_fraction DESC, element
),
fcc_pure_ref AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (element_symbol)
        element_symbol,
        volume_per_atom::double precision AS volume_per_atom,
        ground_state_spacegroup,
        power(4.0 * volume_per_atom::double precision, 1.0 / 3.0) AS matrix_lattice_a
    FROM pure_element_reference
    WHERE volume_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          ground_state_spacegroup ILIKE '%Fm-3m%'
          OR ground_state_spacegroup ILIKE '%225%'
      )
    ORDER BY element_symbol, stability ASC NULLS LAST, energy_per_atom ASC NULLS LAST
),
elastic AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        max(et.youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus_gpa,
        max(et.shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_gpa,
        bool_or(coalesce(et.is_stable, false)) AS mechanically_stable
    FROM calculation c
    JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
stability AS (
    SELECT
        x.entry_id,
        min(x.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        min(x.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom
    FROM (
        SELECT entry_id, energy_above_hull, formation_energy_per_atom
        FROM phase_stability
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entry_id, energy_above_hull, coalesce(corrected_formation_enthalpy, formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom)
        FROM formation_enthalpy
    ) x
    GROUP BY x.entry_id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        l.entry_id,
        l.formula,
        l.chemical_system,
        mc.matrix_element,
        mc.matrix_atomic_fraction,
        l.prototype,
        l.strukturbericht,
        l.space_group_number,
        l.lattice_a AS precipitate_lattice_a,
        pr.matrix_lattice_a,
        abs(l.lattice_a - pr.matrix_lattice_a) / pr.matrix_lattice_a AS lattice_mismatch,
        e.youngs_modulus_gpa,
        e.shear_modulus_gpa,
        coalesce(e.youngs_modulus_gpa, 2.6 * e.shear_modulus_gpa) AS elastic_modulus_score_basis,
        e.mechanically_stable,
        st.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        st.formation_energy_ev_per_atom
    FROM l12_structures l
    JOIN majority_component mc ON mc.entry_id = l.entry_id
    JOIN fcc_pure_ref pr ON pr.element_symbol = mc.matrix_element
    JOIN elastic e ON e.entry_id = l.entry_id
    JOIN stability st ON st.entry_id = l.entry_id
    WHERE pr.matrix_lattice_a > 0
      AND st.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND coalesce(e.youngs_modulus_gpa, e.shear_modulus_gpa) IS NOT NULL
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        m.*,
        CASE
            WHEN max(elastic_modulus_score_basis) OVER () = min(elastic_modulus_score_basis) OVER () THEN 0.5
            ELSE (elastic_modulus_score_basis - min(elastic_modulus_score_basis) OVER ())
                 / nullif(max(elastic_modulus_score_basis) OVER () - min(elastic_modulus_score_basis) OVER (), 0)
        END AS modulus_score
    FROM metrics m
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    chemical_system,
    matrix_element,
    round((100.0 * lattice_mismatch)::numeric, 3) AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    round(youngs_modulus_gpa::numeric, 2) AS youngs_modulus_gpa,
    round(shear_modulus_gpa::numeric, 2) AS shear_modulus_gpa,
    round(energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    round(formation_energy_ev_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    mechanically_stable,
    round((
        0.40 * (1.0 - least(lattice_mismatch / 0.05, 1.0))
        + 0.30 * modulus_score
        + 0.30 * (1.0 - least(greatest(energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom, 0.0) / 0.10, 1.0))
    )::numeric, 4) AS multi_criteria_score
FROM normalized
ORDER BY multi_criteria_score DESC, lattice_mismatch ASC, energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 20;

WITH composition_summary AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        BOOL_OR(c.element = 'Co') AS has_co,
        COUNT(*) AS n_elements,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.element = 'Ni' THEN c.atomic_fraction END) AS ni_fraction,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.element = 'Al' THEN c.atomic_fraction END) AS al_fraction,
        STRING_AGG(c.element || ':' || ROUND(c.atomic_fraction::numeric, 4), ', ' ORDER BY c.element) AS composition
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
l12_structure AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.entry_id)
        s.entry_id,
        s.prototype,
        s.strukturbericht,
        s.space_group_number,
        s.space_group,
        s.crystal_system,
        s.lattice_a,
        s.volume_per_atom
    FROM structure s
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
        ON s.prototype = pd.prototype_id
    WHERE REGEXP_REPLACE(
              TRANSLATE(
                  UPPER(CONCAT_WS(' ', s.prototype, s.strukturbericht, pd.prototype_name, pd.strukturbericht)),
                  '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉',
                  '0123456789'
              ),
              '[^A-Z0-9]',
              '',
              'g'
          ) LIKE '%L12%'
    ORDER BY s.entry_id, s.lattice_a NULLS LAST
),
elastic_summary AS (
    SELECT
        cal.entry_id,
        AVG(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(et.shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(et.youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus,
        BOOL_OR(et.is_stable) AS elastic_stable
    FROM calculation cal
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON cal.calculation_id = et.calculation_id
    GROUP BY cal.entry_id
),
materials AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        cs.composition,
        ls.prototype,
        ls.strukturbericht,
        ls.space_group_number,
        ls.space_group,
        ls.crystal_system,
        ls.lattice_a,
        ls.volume_per_atom,
        COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
        COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        COALESCE(fh.is_stable, ps.is_stable, FALSE) AS thermodynamic_stable,
        es.bulk_modulus_vrh,
        es.shear_modulus_vrh,
        es.youngs_modulus,
        es.elastic_stable,
        cs.has_co,
        cs.n_elements,
        cs.ni_fraction,
        cs.al_fraction
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN composition_summary cs
        ON me.entry_id = cs.entry_id
    JOIN l12_structure ls
        ON me.entry_id = ls.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON me.entry_id = fh.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON me.entry_id = ps.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_summary es
        ON me.entry_id = es.entry_id
),
ni3al AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM materials
    WHERE n_elements = 2
      AND ni_fraction BETWEEN 0.74 AND 0.76
      AND al_fraction BETWEEN 0.24 AND 0.26
    ORDER BY
        COALESCE(energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom, 1e9),
        formation_energy_ev_per_atom NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    m.entry_id,
    m.formula,
    m.reduced_formula,
    m.chemical_system,
    m.composition,
    m.prototype,
    m.strukturbericht,
    m.space_group_number,
    m.space_group,
    ROUND(m.lattice_a::numeric, 4) AS lattice_a_angstrom,
    ROUND(n.lattice_a::numeric, 4) AS ni3al_lattice_a_angstrom,
    ROUND((100.0 * (m.lattice_a - n.lattice_a) / NULLIF(n.lattice_a, 0))::numeric, 3) AS lattice_mismatch_vs_ni3al_pct,
    ROUND(m.formation_energy_ev_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND(n.formation_energy_ev_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS ni3al_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND((m.formation_energy_ev_per_atom - n.formation_energy_ev_per_atom)::numeric, 4) AS delta_formation_energy_vs_ni3al_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND(m.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND(m.bulk_modulus_vrh::numeric, 2) AS bulk_modulus_vrh_gpa,
    ROUND(n.bulk_modulus_vrh::numeric, 2) AS ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh_gpa,
    ROUND((m.bulk_modulus_vrh - n.bulk_modulus_vrh)::numeric, 2) AS delta_bulk_modulus_vs_ni3al_gpa,
    ROUND(m.shear_modulus_vrh::numeric, 2) AS shear_modulus_vrh_gpa,
    ROUND(m.youngs_modulus::numeric, 2) AS youngs_modulus_gpa,
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(100.0 * (m.lattice_a - n.lattice_a) / NULLIF(n.lattice_a, 0)) <= 2.0
             AND (m.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NULL OR n.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NULL OR m.bulk_modulus_vrh >= 0.9 * n.bulk_modulus_vrh)
        THEN 'high_priority_gamma_prime_candidate'
        WHEN ABS(100.0 * (m.lattice_a - n.lattice_a) / NULLIF(n.lattice_a, 0)) <= 5.0
        THEN 'moderate_priority_gamma_prime_candidate'
        ELSE 'lower_priority_due_to_lattice_mismatch'
    END AS assessment_vs_ni3al
FROM materials m
CROSS JOIN ni3al n
WHERE m.has_co
  AND (
        m.thermodynamic_stable IS TRUE
        OR COALESCE(m.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom, 1e9) <= 1e-6
      )
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN ABS(100.0 * (m.lattice_a - n.lattice_a) / NULLIF(n.lattice_a, 0)) <= 2.0
             AND (m.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NULL OR n.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NULL OR m.bulk_modulus_vrh >= 0.9 * n.bulk_modulus_vrh)
        THEN 1
        WHEN ABS(100.0 * (m.lattice_a - n.lattice_a) / NULLIF(n.lattice_a, 0)) <= 5.0
        THEN 2
        ELSE 3
    END,
    ABS(100.0 * (m.lattice_a - n.lattice_a) / NULLIF(n.lattice_a, 0)) NULLS LAST,
    m.energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom NULLS LAST;

WITH pure_refs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (element_symbol)
           element_symbol,
           energy_per_atom::double precision AS energy_per_atom
    FROM pure_element_reference
    WHERE element_symbol IN ('Co', 'Ti')
    ORDER BY element_symbol, stability ASC NULLS LAST, energy_per_atom ASC
),
target_ref AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        SUM(c.atomic_fraction * pr.energy_per_atom) AS pure_reference_energy_ev_per_atom
    FROM composition c
    JOIN pure_refs pr
      ON pr.element_symbol = c.element
    JOIN material_entry me
      ON me.entry_id = c.entry_id
    WHERE me.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti'
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) = 2
)
SELECT
    fe.entry_id,
    fe.formula,
    fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom + fe.weighted_ref_energy AS compound_energy_ev_per_atom,
    tr.pure_reference_energy_ev_per_atom,
    (fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom + fe.weighted_ref_energy) - tr.pure_reference_energy_ev_per_atom AS calculated_formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM formation_enthalpy fe
JOIN target_ref tr
  ON tr.entry_id = fe.entry_id
WHERE fe.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti';

WITH raw AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        me.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        me.reduced_formula,
        COALESCE(fe.prototype, s.prototype, pd.prototype_name) AS prototype,
        COALESCE(fe.strukturbericht, s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
        COALESCE(fe.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
        COALESCE(fe.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fe ON fe.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
),
l12 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM raw
    WHERE formation_energy_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          regexp_replace(upper(translate(COALESCE(strukturbericht, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
          OR regexp_replace(upper(translate(COALESCE(prototype, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
      )
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    reduced_formula,
    prototype,
    strukturbericht,
    formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    CASE
        WHEN formation_energy_ev_per_atom >= 0 AND energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom > 0 THEN 'Q1: ΔHf >= 0, Ehull > 0'
        WHEN formation_energy_ev_per_atom < 0 AND energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom > 0 THEN 'Q2: ΔHf < 0, Ehull > 0'
        WHEN formation_energy_ev_per_atom < 0 AND energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom <= 0 THEN 'Q3: ΔHf < 0, Ehull <= 0'
        WHEN formation_energy_ev_per_atom >= 0 AND energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom <= 0 THEN 'Q4: ΔHf >= 0, Ehull <= 0'
    END AS stability_quadrant
FROM l12
ORDER BY stability_quadrant, energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom, formation_energy_ev_per_atom;

SELECT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  me.chemical_system,
  COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
  COALESCE(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
  COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
  COALESCE(fh.is_stable, ps.is_stable) AS is_stable,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry me
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
  ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
  ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
WHERE
  (
    upper(replace(replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(replace(replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(replace(replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(replace(replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(s.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(replace(replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(fh.prototype, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '')) = 'L12'
    OR upper(replace(replace(replace(replace(COALESCE(pd.prototype_name, ''), '₂', '2'), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '')) = 'L12'
  )
  AND COALESCE(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) ASC,
  COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        COALESCE(fh.formula, me.formula) AS formula,
        COALESCE(fh.reduced_formula, me.reduced_formula) AS reduced_formula,
        me.chemical_system,
        COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
        COALESCE(fh.energy_above_hull, ps.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        COALESCE(fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS formation_energy_per_atom,
        COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, pd.prototype_name) AS prototype,
        COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) AS strukturbericht,
        COALESCE(s.space_group, fh.space_group) AS space_group,
        COALESCE(fh.is_stable, ps.is_stable, FALSE) AS is_stable
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE COALESCE(s.lattice_a, fh.lattice_a) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, fh.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht) ILIKE 'L1%2'
          OR COALESCE(s.prototype, fh.prototype, pd.prototype_name) ILIKE '%L1%2%'
      )
),
ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT AVG(lattice_a) AS ni3al_lattice_a
    FROM l12_entries
    WHERE reduced_formula IN ('Ni3Al', 'AlNi3')
      AND is_stable = TRUE
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT *
    FROM l12_entries
    WHERE is_stable = TRUE
      AND replace(COALESCE(chemical_system, ''), ' ', '') NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
)
SELECT
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY ABS((c.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a)
    ) AS lattice_match_rank,
    c.entry_id,
    c.formula,
    c.reduced_formula,
    c.chemical_system,
    c.prototype,
    c.strukturbericht,
    c.space_group,
    c.lattice_a AS candidate_lattice_a,
    r.ni3al_lattice_a AS reference_ni3al_lattice_a,
    ROUND((100.0 * (c.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a)::numeric, 3) AS lattice_mismatch_percent,
    c.energy_above_hull,
    c.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM candidates c
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref r
WHERE r.ni3al_lattice_a IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    ABS((c.lattice_a - r.ni3al_lattice_a) / r.ni3al_lattice_a),
    c.energy_above_hull NULLS LAST;

SELECT DISTINCT
  me.entry_id,
  me.formula,
  s.lattice_a AS lattice_constant,
  et.bulk_modulus_vrh AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry AS me
JOIN structure AS s
  ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN calculation AS c
  ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor AS et
  ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
LEFT JOIN prototype_definition AS pd
  ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
WHERE s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR pd.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR s.prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR pd.prototype_name ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY s.lattice_a, et.bulk_modulus_vrh;

WITH raw AS (
    SELECT
        me.entry_id,
        c.element AS a_site_element,
        e.period_number,
        CASE e.period_number
            WHEN 4 THEN '3d (period 4)'
            WHEN 5 THEN '4d (period 5)'
            WHEN 6 THEN '5d (period 6)'
        END AS transition_metal_series,
        e.period_number - 3 AS sort_order,
        COALESCE(ps.energy_above_hull, fh.energy_above_hull, pde.hull_distance) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        COALESCE(ps.formation_energy_per_atom, fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
        COALESCE(ps.is_stable, fh.is_stable, pde.is_on_hull) AS is_stable_raw
    FROM material_entry me
    JOIN composition c
        ON c.entry_id = me.entry_id
    JOIN element e
        ON e.symbol = c.element
    LEFT JOIN structure s
        ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
        ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_stability ps
        ON ps.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_diagram_entry pde
        ON pde.entry_id = me.entry_id
    WHERE (
        regexp_replace(upper(replace(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
        OR regexp_replace(upper(replace(coalesce(fh.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
        OR regexp_replace(upper(replace(coalesce(pd.strukturbericht, ''), '₂', '2')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
        OR regexp_replace(
            upper(replace(
                coalesce(s.prototype, '') || ' ' ||
                coalesce(fh.prototype, '') || ' ' ||
                coalesce(pd.prototype_name, '') || ' ' ||
                coalesce(pd.description, ''),
                '₂', '2'
            )),
            '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g'
        ) LIKE '%L12%'
    )
      AND regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(c.site_label, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') IN ('A', 'ASITE')
      AND e.block = 'd'
      AND e.group_number BETWEEN 3 AND 12
      AND e.period_number IN (4, 5, 6)
),
material_level AS (
    SELECT
        entry_id,
        a_site_element,
        period_number,
        transition_metal_series,
        sort_order,
        MIN(energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom) AS energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        MIN(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
        BOOL_OR(is_stable_raw) AS is_stable_raw
    FROM raw
    GROUP BY entry_id, a_site_element, period_number, transition_metal_series, sort_order
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(is_stable_raw, energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom <= 0.025) AS is_stable
    FROM material_level
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        transition_metal_series,
        sort_order,
        COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) AS n_l12_compounds,
        string_agg(DISTINCT a_site_element, ', ' ORDER BY a_site_element) AS a_site_elements,
        COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) FILTER (WHERE is_stable) AS n_stable,
        COUNT(DISTINCT entry_id) FILTER (WHERE is_stable IS NOT NULL) AS n_with_stability_label,
        AVG(energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom) AS avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom) AS median_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
        AVG(formation_energy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom
    FROM normalized
    GROUP BY transition_metal_series, sort_order
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom AS avg_ehull_3d
    FROM agg
    WHERE sort_order = 1
)
SELECT
    a.transition_metal_series,
    a.n_l12_compounds,
    a.a_site_elements,
    a.n_stable,
    ROUND((a.n_stable::numeric / NULLIF(a.n_with_stability_label, 0)), 3) AS stable_fraction,
    ROUND(a.avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND(a.median_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS median_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND(a.avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS avg_formation_energy_ev_per_atom,
    ROUND((a.avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom - b.avg_ehull_3d)::numeric, 4) AS avg_hull_delta_vs_3d_ev_per_atom,
    CASE
        WHEN a.avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom IS NULL OR b.avg_ehull_3d IS NULL THEN NULL
        WHEN a.sort_order = 1 THEN '3d baseline'
        WHEN a.avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom < b.avg_ehull_3d THEN 'more stable than 3d on average'
        WHEN a.avg_energy_above_hull_ev_per_atom > b.avg_ehull_3d THEN 'less stable than 3d on average'
        ELSE 'similar to 3d on average'
    END AS stability_trend_vs_3d
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN baseline b ON TRUE
ORDER BY a.sort_order;

WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.entry_id
    FROM structure s
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd
        ON s.prototype = pd.prototype_id
    WHERE regexp_replace(replace(replace(upper(coalesce(s.strukturbericht, pd.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '₁', '1'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
       OR regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(s.prototype, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%CU3AU%'
       OR regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(pd.prototype_name, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%CU3AU%'

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT fh.entry_id
    FROM formation_enthalpy fh
    WHERE regexp_replace(replace(replace(upper(coalesce(fh.strukturbericht, '')), '₂', '2'), '₁', '1'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'L12'
       OR regexp_replace(upper(coalesce(fh.prototype, '')), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g') LIKE '%CU3AU%'
),
entry_props AS (
    SELECT
        le.entry_id,
        MIN(coalesce(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom)) AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
        MIN(fh.energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull,
        MAX(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM l12_entries le
    JOIN formation_enthalpy fh
        ON fh.entry_id = le.entry_id
    JOIN calculation c
        ON c.entry_id = le.entry_id
    JOIN elastic_tensor et
        ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
    WHERE coalesce(fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) IS NOT NULL
      AND et.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY le.entry_id
),
ni3al_entries AS (
    SELECT c.entry_id
    FROM composition c
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.element) = 2
       AND abs(SUM(CASE WHEN c.element = 'Ni' THEN c.atomic_fraction ELSE 0 END) - 0.75) < 1e-4
       AND abs(SUM(CASE WHEN c.element = 'Al' THEN c.atomic_fraction ELSE 0 END) - 0.25) < 1e-4
),
ni3al_ref AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(ep.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS ni3al_formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
        MAX(ep.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
    FROM entry_props ep
    JOIN ni3al_entries ne
        ON ne.entry_id = ep.entry_id
)
SELECT
    me.entry_id,
    me.formula,
    me.reduced_formula,
    me.chemical_system,
    ep.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
    ep.energy_above_hull,
    ep.bulk_modulus_vrh
FROM entry_props ep
JOIN material_entry me
    ON me.entry_id = ep.entry_id
CROSS JOIN ni3al_ref nr
WHERE ep.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom < nr.ni3al_formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
  AND ep.bulk_modulus_vrh > nr.ni3al_bulk_modulus_vrh
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM ni3al_entries ne
      WHERE ne.entry_id = ep.entry_id
  )
ORDER BY ep.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC, ep.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC;

SELECT
  f.entry_id,
  f.formula,
  f.reduced_formula,
  COALESCE(f.corrected_formation_enthalpy, f.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  COALESCE(s.lattice_a, f.lattice_a) AS lattice_a,
  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c
FROM formation_enthalpy f
LEFT JOIN structure s
  ON s.entry_id = f.entry_id
WHERE f.is_stable = TRUE
  AND COALESCE(f.corrected_formation_enthalpy, f.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) < -0.3
  AND (
    LOWER(COALESCE(f.strukturbericht, '')) IN ('l12', 'l1_2', 'l1₂')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.strukturbericht, '')) IN ('l12', 'l1_2', 'l1₂')
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(f.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l12%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(f.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l1_2%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(f.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l1₂%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l12%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l1_2%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(s.prototype, '')) LIKE '%l1₂%'
  )
ORDER BY formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC;

WITH l12_entries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT me.entry_id
    FROM material_entry me
    LEFT JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN formation_enthalpy fh ON fh.entry_id = me.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN prototype_definition pd ON pd.prototype_id = s.prototype
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM (
            VALUES
                (s.strukturbericht),
                (s.prototype),
                (pd.strukturbericht),
                (pd.prototype_name),
                (fh.strukturbericht),
                (fh.prototype)
        ) AS v(x)
        WHERE upper(regexp_replace(translate(coalesce(v.x, ''), '₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉', '0123456789'), '[^A-Z0-9]', '', 'g')) LIKE '%L12%'
    )
),
phase_agg AS (
    SELECT entry_id, MIN(energy_above_hull) AS energy_above_hull
    FROM (
        SELECT entry_id, energy_above_hull FROM phase_stability
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entry_id, energy_above_hull FROM formation_enthalpy
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entry_id, hull_distance AS energy_above_hull FROM phase_diagram_entry
    ) x
    WHERE energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
lattice_agg AS (
    SELECT entry_id, AVG(lattice_a) AS lattice_a
    FROM (
        SELECT entry_id, lattice_a FROM structure
        UNION ALL
        SELECT entry_id, lattice_a FROM formation_enthalpy
    ) x
    WHERE lattice_a IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY entry_id
),
elastic_agg AS (
    SELECT
        c.entry_id,
        AVG(et.bulk_modulus_vrh) AS bulk_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(et.shear_modulus_vrh) AS shear_modulus_vrh,
        AVG(et.youngs_modulus) AS youngs_modulus,
        BOOL_AND(COALESCE(et.is_stable, TRUE)) AS elastic_is_stable
    FROM calculation c
    JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.calculation_id = c.calculation_id
    JOIN l12_entries le ON le.entry_id = c.entry_id
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
),
elastic_extrema AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS min_bulk,
        MAX(bulk_modulus_vrh) AS max_bulk,
        MIN(shear_modulus_vrh) AS min_shear,
        MAX(shear_modulus_vrh) AS max_shear,
        MIN(youngs_modulus) AS min_young,
        MAX(youngs_modulus) AS max_young
    FROM elastic_agg
),
elastic_norm AS (
    SELECT
        n.entry_id,
        CASE
            WHEN ((n.bulk_norm IS NOT NULL)::int + (n.shear_norm IS NOT NULL)::int + (n.young_norm IS NOT NULL)::int) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE
                CASE WHEN COALESCE(n.elastic_is_stable, TRUE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
                * (
                    COALESCE(n.bulk_norm, 0.0)
                    + COALESCE(n.shear_norm, 0.0)
                    + COALESCE(n.young_norm, 0.0)
                )
                / NULLIF(((n.bulk_norm IS NOT NULL)::int + (n.shear_norm IS NOT NULL)::int + (n.young_norm IS NOT NULL)::int), 0)
        END AS elastic_score
    FROM (
        SELECT
            e.*,
            CASE
                WHEN e.bulk_modulus_vrh IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN x.max_bulk = x.min_bulk THEN 1.0
                ELSE (e.bulk_modulus_vrh - x.min_bulk) / NULLIF(x.max_bulk - x.min_bulk, 0.0)
            END AS bulk_norm,
            CASE
                WHEN e.shear_modulus_vrh IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN x.max_shear = x.min_shear THEN 1.0
                ELSE (e.shear_modulus_vrh - x.min_shear) / NULLIF(x.max_shear - x.min_shear, 0.0)
            END AS shear_norm,
            CASE
                WHEN e.youngs_modulus IS NULL THEN NULL
                WHEN x.max_young = x.min_young THEN 1.0
                ELSE (e.youngs_modulus - x.min_young) / NULLIF(x.max_young - x.min_young, 0.0)
            END AS young_norm
        FROM elastic_agg e
        CROSS JOIN elastic_extrema x
    ) n
),
target_lattice AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT POWER(4.0 * per.volume_per_atom, 1.0 / 3.0)
            FROM pure_element_reference per
            WHERE per.element_symbol = 'Ni'
              AND per.volume_per_atom IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY per.stability NULLS LAST
            LIMIT 1
        ),
        3.52
    ) AS a_ref
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        le.entry_id,
        me.formula,
        p.energy_above_hull,
        l.lattice_a,
        e.elastic_score,
        GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(1.0, 1.0 - COALESCE(p.energy_above_hull, 1.0) / 0.10)) AS stability_score,
        CASE
            WHEN l.lattice_a IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE GREATEST(0.0, LEAST(1.0, 1.0 - ABS(l.lattice_a - t.a_ref) / t.a_ref / 0.05))
        END AS lattice_matching_score
    FROM l12_entries le
    JOIN material_entry me ON me.entry_id = le.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN phase_agg p ON p.entry_id = le.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN lattice_agg l ON l.entry_id = le.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN elastic_norm e ON e.entry_id = le.entry_id
    CROSS JOIN target_lattice t
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        stability_score * lattice_matching_score * elastic_score AS composite_score
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    entry_id,
    formula,
    energy_above_hull,
    lattice_a,
    stability_score,
    lattice_matching_score,
    elastic_score,
    composite_score,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY composite_score DESC NULLS LAST) AS composite_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY composite_rank, entry_id;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site_element,
  AVG(f.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom
FROM formation_enthalpy AS f
JOIN composition AS c
  ON c.entry_id = f.entry_id
WHERE f.is_stable = TRUE
  AND f.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  AND c.site_label = 'A'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element;

SELECT
  fe.entry_id,
  fe.formula,
  fe.reduced_formula,
  COALESCE(fe.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) AS formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  fe.energy_above_hull,
  fe.prototype,
  fe.strukturbericht
FROM formation_enthalpy AS fe
JOIN material_entry AS me
  ON me.entry_id = fe.entry_id
WHERE fe.is_stable = TRUE
  AND me.number_of_elements > 1
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition AS c
    WHERE c.entry_id = fe.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
  AND (
    fe.strukturbericht ~* '^L1[_ -]?2$'
    OR fe.prototype ~* 'L1[_ -]?2'
  )
ORDER BY COALESCE(fe.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fe.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  entry_id,
  formula,
  reduced_formula,
  formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom,
  weighted_ref_energy,
  prototype,
  strukturbericht
FROM formation_enthalpy
WHERE (
    strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L1_2%'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L12%'
    OR prototype ILIKE '%L1₂%'
  )
  AND formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom <= -0.1;
